 VIDEO: Cornyn Introduces James Sullivan in Judiciary Committee to be a U.S. District Judge for the Western District of Texas
 November 18, 2026 
 For a long time now, Senator Cruz and I have had a bipartisan Federal Judicial Evaluation Committee that has helped us in this process… Judge Sullivan was a product of that process and came out very highly rated.
In each of the roles that Justice Sullivan has held, he's demonstrated exceptional legal acumen and personal integrity.
I have no doubt about his ability to serve in this important position.
 WASHINGTON – Today, U.S. Senator John Cornyn (R-TX) introduced Texan and U.S. District Judge for the Western District of Texas nominee James Sullivan at his nomination hearing in the Senate Judiciary Committee. Excerpts from his remarks are below, and video can be found here . 
 “For a long time now, Senator Cruz and I have had a bipartisan Federal Judicial Evaluation Committee that has helped us in this process and by vetting the various people who have indicated some interest, and Judge Sullivan was a product of that process and came out very highly rated.” 
 “Before joining the Texas Supreme Court, where I happened to have worked for about seven years as well, Judge Sullivan was General Counsel to Governor Greg Abbott.” 
 “In each of the roles that Justice Sullivan has held, he’s demonstrated exceptional legal acumen and personal integrity.” 
 “He played football at Westlake High School, which is a powerhouse in Austin, Texas… and he also of course [is] a proud alumni of Rice and Harvard Law School.” 
 “I have no doubt about his ability to serve in this important position.” 
 “Congratulations, James, on your nomination, and I look forward to supporting your confirmation here in the committee and on the Senate floor.”
